## Reproducibility checklist

- [ ] I documented the dataset origin, licence and any redistribution restrictions.
- [ ] I documented frequency units, sampling assumptions and machinery conditions.
- [ ] I included runnable examples or tests.
- [ ] I clearly distinguish simulation from real measurements and fault accuracy.
- [ ] No confidential sensor recordings or credentials are committed.
